from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
p=Path('opsd_de_load.csv')
print('exists', p.exists(), 'size', p.stat().st_size if p.exists() else None)
if p.exists():
    df=pd.read_csv(p, parse_dates=['utc_timestamp'])
    print('shape', df.shape)
    print('columns', list(df.columns))
    print('start', df['utc_timestamp'].iloc[0], 'end', df['utc_timestamp'].iloc[-1])
    print('nan', int(df.isna().sum().sum()))
    d=df['utc_timestamp'].diff().dropna()
    print('gaps', int((d != pd.Timedelta(hours=1)).sum()))
